about: Invented lore for the road condition reader (#4258, memory/route_condition.py; #4982). `cases`: a route and its value (open, hard, closed, gone); `between`: the road between two places and its value. `must_not` names a route and its sentence; that route must give nothing.

must_not.line: Travelers say Ironpeak Pass is snowed in.
If Hagmire Road is flooded, we turn back.
Gullet Pass was closed until spring.
A blizzard on Highcrag Pass slowed us for a day.
The road to Icewind Pass is closed.
Dunmore Bridge is out of reach of the carts.
Reedway is no more than a muddy track.
